source_state: Uncommitted candidate; source snapshots and SHA256 bindings identify actual tested inputs. No commit or hosted CI run claimed.
toolchain_policy: Latest stable only, as requested by the user. Historical MSRV receipts remain historical.
scope: One finite offline Draft2020-12 schema family through the actual companion Adapter and production jsonschema0.33.0 validator. Test-only backend, no implicit serializer selection.

resource_profile.integer_literals: signed i64 only; independently tested schemas constrain to signed32bit
resource_profile.floating_spellings: At most8 fractional digits, exponent-6..6, mantissa/result magnitude<=1e6
resource_profile.references: exact explicit URIs, acyclic only; no patterns/dynamic references/anchors

retained_failures: The first four-test run passed before resource/numeric/version-pin hardening; final whole companion gates and peers bind the final source.
The independent negative control deliberately changes an actual Rust numeric payload to a string and fails.
limits: Finite schema family; unsupported keywords, cycles and numeric spellings return explicit errors. No arbitrary schema or arbitrary-decimal qualification.
Input/value/graph bounds do not establish process RSS, backend allocator quotas or performance ranking. Caller-owned values remain the caller responsibility.
No live Registry/broker, schema registration or runtime validator dependency. Companion remains unpublished.
Synchronous test-only compiler/validator work is bounded by the selected finite profile and CI timeout, not a production async execution deadline.
